subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Safety in the home
source.subtopic: Dangers at home: cooking, washing, lighting and electricity, outside areas, medicine

show.line: Home can have dangers. Hot stoves, plugs, medicine and buckets of water!

rounds.prompt: Which is dangerous for a child to touch?
The kettle just boiled. What do you do?
Baby crawls to the bucket of water. What do you do?
Which shows the pot handle turned in safely?

hints: Hot, sharp, electric and medicine are for grown-ups.
If in doubt, call a grown-up.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The plug looks fun.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will poke the plug with a fork!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Never put things in plugs.

parent_line: Can name dangers at home: heat, electricity, medicine and water.
